_comment: Conformance vectors for DegeneracyGuard. Both legs must produce identical verdicts for each input. Verdict is encoded as the case discriminant string. Diagnostic strings are not compared — they are implementation-defined text. See DegeneracyGuard.swift for the algorithm.

classify_cases.note: Three identical rankings → Jaccard divergence 0.0 and rank divergence 0.0 across all pairs → queryInvariant
Three meaningfully distinct rankings → high pairwise divergence → healthy
Fewer than 2 probes → cannot detect invariance → healthy
Empty probe set → healthy (no evidence of invariance)
Two identical probes → both axes 0.0 < threshold → queryInvariant
Two probes with reversed order → rank divergence 1.0 > threshold → healthy

text_blocks: hint: No results matched your query.
fallback_cases.note: found N > 0 AND hint: keyword → degraded fallback signal
found 0 is honest empty result, not a fallback contradiction
found N with actual result lines — not a degraded fallback
found N > 0 AND 'no results' keyword co-present → fallback
found N > 0 AND 'fallback' keyword co-present → fallback
Empty text blocks → no found-N pattern → false

confirmation_cases.note: confirmedCount=0, recall=1.0 → contradiction above the 0.5 floor
confirmedCount=0 with recall=0 → consistent (nothing recalled, nothing confirmed)
total=0 → guard returns false (no data to contradict)
recall=0.5 is NOT above the floor (floor is 0.5, check is >0.5) → no contradiction
recall=0.51 is above the 0.5 floor → contradiction
